test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

At the drop of a dime

options.text: A way of saying that you are happy to see someone
Something that can happen very fast without hesitation

solution:
The correct option is **"Something that can happen very fast without hesitation"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **idiom** is a group of words that together have a figurative, supplementary meaning that cannot be deduced from the words' individual meanings.
 
• If someone is willing to act immediately and without **hesitation**, they will do it at the** drop of a dime**.
 
• The third option matches the meaning of the given question. Anything that can occur without warning and extremely quickly is referred by **"****At the drop of a dime"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first option is not correct because its meaning is a way of expressing joy in someone's **presence**.
 
• An **unpopular thing** is referred to by the second option. So this is not the correct one.
 
• The thing which is very easy to understand is not matching the given** idiom**.
 
• Therefore, the above three options are not correct or **appropriate meaning**.
